zh-Hans: 修复主窗口、快捷窗口和设置页未跟随系统深色模式的问题
改善深色模式下图标、文字和选中状态的可见性
支持运行中实时切换深浅外观，并保留原有浅色配色
en: Fixed system dark mode support in the main window, quick panel, and settings
Improved icon, text, and selection visibility in dark mode
Appearance updates immediately when the system theme changes, preserving the existing light palette
